QuestInfo.name: POLLUTED! <3-Jr. Boogie>
QuestInfo.0: I heard there's a warning sign on monsters somewhere around The South Rocky Mountain Perion Southern Ridge...
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the Jr. Boogies you find at The South Rocky Mountain Perion Southern Ridge and bring back #b12#k Horns of Jr. Boogie to 'The Rememberer' as proof. \n\n#i4000067##t4000067# #b#c4000067##k/12
QuestInfo.2: The dungeon now features strange monsters such as Jr. Boogie. Wonder if there's more coming...

0.0: Go defeat Jr. Boogie, and bring back 12 of its horns...\n#r- The Rememberer -

yes.0: Make sure to report the result to #rThe Rememberer#k after eliminating the monsters!

1.0: Ahh, concentrate! Phew... the art of levitation is such a delicate one that requires so much energy and effort, that one mishap can surely ruin it all. Please talk to me in whispers next time!
1.1: Anyway how can I help you? Oh! You! Did you find the Jr. Boogies by chance? Ever since they transformed into a hideous creature thanks to pollution, they have been notorious for attacking travelers from left and right. I know it's only 12, but I think that buys some time for travelers to walk around safely for a few. Were their horns contaminated, too? I knew it. For you to endure its attack looking unscathed... wow...

yes.0: I can tell you're noble enough to do this without expecting anything return, but this is just my way of saying thank you for helping us out. Please take it.
yes.1: You're not ending your travels right now, are you? There are many dangerous monsters outside the town. I have installed warning signs here and there, so go check them out. You will be given a generous reward! Beware of the monsters!

item.0: Whew! That was close. Please speak quietly... Come see me again after you defeat Jr. Boogie and bring back #b12 #t4000067#s#k.
